mentions.name: Old-style RTS game
mentions.description: A retro-style real-time strategy (RTS) game built with AI-assisted coding (Claude for the code), while exploring how far local AI models can be pushed to generate art assets such as drawings, 3D models, rigging, and sprites.
mentions.problem: Integrating AI-generated code with graphics still requires plenty of "manual" work.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm vibing an old style RTS game and exploring how far can I get with local models for drawing, 3D models, rigging and sprites. I love how much I can accomplish with Claude in terms of code, but gluing it all together with graphics still requires plenty of "manual" work.
mentions.author: snicky
